scope: Private guarded 64K frozen Task06 run; public release remains paused
raw_evidence: evals/runs/t06lineage64/evidence/full-agent (ignored private native event and resource records)
trigger: A frozen Task06 Agent turn received a running evaluator-owned server URL and a one-shot 503 marker. After reading the project, Agent inspected the server PID and issued a shell command starting with kill 68115, followed by a server restart attempt.
observed: The existing broad pkill guard refused a prior attempt, but the exact-PID kill was admitted. The evaluator server exited with code 143, and the browser then reported connection refused. No source file was edited or controlled 503 consumed. The operator interrupted the run at 274.154 seconds; no completed Agent turn, compaction, restart, or browser acceptance can be claimed. The owned model runtime subsequently passed doctor with 65,536 context, normal memory pressure, unchanged swap, idle requests and connected browser/search.
fix: Refuse direct kill, pkill and killall at simple shell command positions before native execution. The native owned background-session lifecycle remains the route for an Agent to stop its own server. Quoted literals and heredoc bodies remain data. The command scanner is not whole-process isolation or protection against indirect signaling APIs.
